observations.disposition_note: Anchor lacked Atrium name; narrowed via Note 13 judgment.

The settlement and the resulting $5,450,000 loan payable are one reported event stated in one sentence; the finding's single checkable claim is that the Atrium settlement created a $5,450,000 loan payable.

The Note 11 passage does not itself name Atrium; the link is explicitly marked as an inference (matching $5,450,000 amount, December 2023 date and Note 13's 'see Note 11' cross-reference; the Atrium row in the notes table carries the same $4,802,445 balance). The $2,000,000 2024 amount is stated directly in the schedule.
The single checkable claim is the $2,000,000 2024 scheduled amount; the Atrium identification is a labeled inference, not a separate asserted fact.
One claim: the $600,000 2024 scheduled amount; the VitBest label is a marked inference by balance match.

This is a cross-default covenant, i.e., a funding constraint linking any third-party debt default (including on a new advance) to automatic default of the senior Knight loan; it creates no scheduled cash payment by itself.
Single checkable fact: $1,716,496 received in July-August 2024; the counterparty description identifies the note rather than asserting a separate fact.
One fact: full payment of the LODC settlement in May 2024, verbatim.

The quoted sentence closes the Valenti paragraph (read in full in s0121), which describes the $340,000 settlement with Valenti payable in twelve installments ending December 1, 2023; 'the $340,000' refers to that settlement.
One fact: the Valenti settlement was fully paid in 2023.
